name: Containerization Best Practices
description: This module captures the best practices for containerization, distilled from common failure modes and what tends to hold up over time.
content:
This module captures the best practices for containerization, distilled from common failure modes and what tends to hold up over time.

CORE GUIDELINES
1. Before starting containerization work, confirm the scope and constraints so the approach matches the actual requirement.
2. Measure before optimizing any containerization bottleneck; do not guess at what is slow.
3. When containerization decisions are ambiguous, favor the option that is easiest to reverse or extend later.
4. Validate containerization outputs against a concrete example before treating the work as complete.
5. Keep containerization changes scoped to what was asked; avoid unrelated cleanup in the same pass.
6. When containerization guidance conflicts with a specific user instruction, defer to the user's explicit instruction and note the conflict.
7. Prefer the simplest containerization approach that satisfies the requirement over a more general one that isn't needed yet.
8. Check that containerization terminology is used consistently throughout, matching existing conventions in the surrounding context.
9. Surface known limitations of a chosen containerization approach instead of presenting it as complete when it is not.
10. Prefer explicit, readable containerization solutions over clever ones that are hard to verify.
11. State assumptions about containerization explicitly before proceeding, rather than leaving them implicit.

COMMON PITFALLS TO AVOID
- Do not treat a single passing example as full verification of containerization correctness.
- Avoid introducing new containerization abstractions before there is a second concrete use case that needs them.
- Do not apply generic containerization advice without checking it fits the specific context at hand.

CLOSING NOTE
Revisit these containerization guidelines if the task's constraints change significantly during the work.
